functionality: download and run additional malicious scripts
operational_techniques: using history stack as an oracle
related_malicious_code_snippet: Creating an IFrame that points to the login page in the vulnerable website (this page should be pushed to the history stack).
Read the current length of the history stack (using length) and save it.
Change the IFrame src attribute to a URL of a protected page and read the length again.
mitigation_measures: set frame-ancestors directive of the CSP Header to none
